This document has been **consolidated**.

Please use:

- [RFD 0108](https://github.com/weftspun/request-for-discussion/tree/main/0108-xr-mode-floor-anchoring-and-backgrounds), `weftspun/request-for-discussion`

It contains the current correct behavior for:
- Android XR `bounded-floor` floor-level anchoring
- AR pass-through transparency requirements
- VR background behavior
- Current XR wrapper positioning rules (including **X=0**, **Z=-0.5**, **Y computed from bounding box**)
